_comment: Human-verified mark allocations, applied by build/index_questions.py.
These exist because some allocations cannot be read automatically: 2024
Q29(a) is printed as a damaged glyph in the scan itself, not a digit.
This file is committed on purpose. work/ is gitignored and regenerated, so
a verified reading recorded only there would be lost on the next rebuild.
Keys are question number + part label, e.g. '29a', '30b(i)'.
